div.div:
CVA6 path (CoreType = platform_pkg::CoreCva6; dashed):
- replaces core_region, the OBI buffers, routers and OBI->AXI bridges with corejack_cva6_axi_adapter
- axi_isolate on rst_ni, then axi_demux: RAM window -> its own soc_axi_to_mem -> soc_mem_ss ports 5/6; everything else -> xbar AXI[0]
- core_axi_req[1] is tied to '0; the SBA path (core_axi_req[2]) is unchanged
- sim + FPGA + debug supported (cfg/cores/cva6.yaml)

blue = bus/fabric
green = CPU / core region
purple = memory
orange = debug
yellow = peripherals (UART)
red = reset
white = pin / external
